subject.title: Workspaces: persist widget state in SQLite

question: Should approved custom widgets receive this durable `state:persist` capability and parent-mediated gateway write path backed by the Workspaces SQLite database?
rationale: The branch permanently expands the custom-widget sandbox contract, plugin API, and stored data model; tests can validate mechanics but cannot decide whether maintainers accept that long-term product and security boundary.

options.title: Approve the proposed contract
options.body: Accept the capability, RPCs, schema, limits, identity binding, concurrency behavior, and cleanup after real browser proof and corrected issue linkage.

options.title: Restrict state to trusted built-ins
options.body: Remove custom-widget bridge access and expose persistence only to first-party Workspaces widgets through a narrower internal accessor.

options.title: Keep custom widgets read-only
options.body: Decline this persistence boundary and pause dependent stateful-widget work until a different design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve the proposed contract
recommendation.body: Accept the capability, RPCs, schema, limits, identity binding, concurrency behavior, and cleanup after real browser proof and corrected issue linkage.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged Workspaces foundation established the current plugin persistence and sandbox architecture that this PR extends.
